edits.text: 2. CONFIDENTIALITY. Each party receiving the other party’s confidential information shall use it solely to evaluate the potential transaction and shall protect it from unauthorized disclosure for three years from the date of disclosure. This obligation survives expiration or termination of this Agreement. Confidential information does not include information the receiving party can demonstrate (a) was already known to it without a duty of confidentiality, (b) is or becomes public other than through its breach of this Agreement, (c) was independently developed without use of the disclosing party’s confidential information, or (d) was lawfully received from a third party without a duty of confidentiality. The receiving party may disclose confidential information to its professional advisers who need to know it for the stated purpose and are bound by confidentiality obligations; the receiving party remains responsible for their compliance with this Agreement. The receiving party may also disclose confidential information to the extent legally required, provided it gives the disclosing party prompt notice where legally permitted and reasonably cooperates, at the disclosing party’s expense, with efforts to seek confidential treatment or limit disclosure. On request, the receiving party shall promptly return or destroy the disclosing party’s confidential information, except for copies retained under routine archival procedures or legal-retention requirements. Retained copies remain subject to this Section 2 for the remainder of the applicable three-year period.

delivered.body: Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement PARTIES. This Agreement is between Northwind Capital and Oakstone Ventures. 1. PURPOSE. The parties wish to explore a potential transaction and will share confidential information. 2. CONFIDENTIALITY. Each party receiving the other party’s confidential information shall use it solely to evaluate the potential transaction and shall protect it from unauthorized disclosure for three years from the date of disclosure. This obligation survives expiration or termination of this Agreement. 3. TERM. This Agreement remains in effect for twenty-four months from the date of signing. 4. REMEDIES. Breach may be enjoined and damages sought.
